description:
Miss America, Miss USA, Miss Universe—even shows like Toddlers & Tiaras and Insatiable glamorize beauty pageants, but few talk about what it's really like behind the crown. What started in beauty pageants led to acting roles and red carpets, until God opened her eyes to the reality of the spotlight. In this powerful testimony, she shares how He called her out of performance and into purpose, trading fame for faith and finding a beauty that never fades.
